sop_modules.name: Setup — Protection + Equipment
sop_modules.description: Full setup module for exterior masonry repaint. Landscape perimeter protection (LF-based, catches scraping debris + overspray), hardscape walk/patio protection, light fixture and HVAC masking, vehicle/driveway protection (RP-specific, occupied home, spray only), ground cover below work zone (scraping debris containment), equipment setup.

tasks.name: Landscape Perimeter Protection Setup
tasks.description: Deploy tarps and plastic sheeting along house perimeter where landscape is adjacent. RP scope includes scraping debris and power wash runoff containment.

tasks.name: Hardscape Protection Setup
tasks.description: Deploy drop cloths on walkways and patios adjacent to masonry wall. Canvas for non-slip crew traffic.

tasks.name: Fixture and Utility Masking
tasks.description: Mask exterior light fixtures, utility panels. Bag and tape HVAC units if adjacent. RP: all fixtures installed and operational.

tasks.name: Vehicle/Driveway Overspray Protection
tasks.description: Deploy poly sheeting over vehicles and driveway. RP-specific — occupied home context. spray_backroll only.

tasks.name: Ground Protection — Scraping Debris Containment
tasks.description: Deploy ground cover below masonry work zone for scraping debris, power wash runoff, and paint drips. Active for FAIR/POOR conditions. Always active for spray_backroll.

tasks.name: Spray/Backroll Equipment Setup
tasks.description: Configure airless sprayer, hoses, tips for masonry. Stage 18-inch backroll frame + roller covers. Stage ladders/scaffold per access_type. 2-person crew.

tasks.name: Brush/Roll Equipment Setup
tasks.description: Stage brushes, rollers, trays, materials. Set up ladders/scaffold per access_type. Fallback method.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Landscape/hardscape protection -> Fixture/HVAC masking -> Vehicle protection (spray only) -> Ground cover -> Equipment setup last.

sop_modules.name: Condition Assessment — Visual, Chalk, Adhesion, Efflorescence, Moisture, Mortar, Crack
sop_modules.description: RP-specific multi-point assessment module for masonry. Results drive substrate state assignment, primer selection, prep intensity, and condition scale. 7 assessment tasks. All FIXED per elevation.

tasks.name: Visual Condition Inspection Per Elevation
tasks.description: Scan all masonry wall surfaces per elevation. Map cracking, peeling, adhesion failure, chalking, efflorescence, mortar deterioration. Assign substrate state per worst-state-wins. Photograph defects.

quality_notes.QT2: Quick ground-level scan. Note obvious defects.
quality_notes.QT3: Standard visual with work light, document defects per elevation.
quality_notes.QT4: Systematic scan, photograph all defect areas, per-elevation assessment.

tasks.name: Chalk Test (White Cloth Rub)
tasks.description: Rub white cloth across painted masonry surfaces. Grade: none/light/moderate/heavy. Moderate/heavy triggers chalk-binding primer. Less common on masonry than FC siding but occurs on smooth-painted block and concrete.

tasks.name: Adhesion Test (ASTM D3359)
tasks.description: Cross-hatch tape test at representative sections per elevation. 2+ locations per elevation. Results determine prime/skip-prime path.

tasks.name: Efflorescence Scan Per Elevation
tasks.description: Inspect for white crystalline salt deposits on masonry surfaces. Distinguish dormant (treatable) from active/recurring (STOP WORK). Document locations and severity. Masonry-specific assessment not present in siding/trim RP.

tasks.name: Moisture Test (ASTM D4263) Per Elevation
tasks.description: Moisture meter reading at multiple locations: base of wall (rising damp), near joints (water intrusion), efflorescence areas, below window sills (splash zones). MC > 12% = STOP WORK for coating. Masonry holds moisture longer than other substrates.

tasks.name: Mortar Joint / Tuck-Point Assessment
tasks.description: Evaluate mortar joint condition per elevation. Identify cracked, eroded, or missing mortar. Minor hairline cracking (<1/16 inch) is paintable. Significant deterioration = flag for tuck-pointing (masonry trade, outside painting scope) before painting proceeds.

tasks.name: Crack Mapping — Structural vs Cosmetic
tasks.description: Map visible cracks on masonry surface. Classify as cosmetic (hairline, <1/4 inch — fillable, within painting scope) or structural (>1/4 inch, displacement visible — outside painting scope, refer to structural engineer). Document crack locations for downstream prep tasks.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Visual condition first -> Chalk test -> Adhesion test -> Efflorescence scan -> Moisture test -> Mortar assessment -> Crack mapping. Assessment results drive all downstream task activation.

sop_modules.name: Surface Preparation — Power Wash, Efflorescence Treatment, Chalk Remediation, Scrape/Feather, Crack Fill, Spall Patch
sop_modules.description: Condition-driven surface prep for masonry RP. Power washing IS allowed on masonry (1500-3000 PSI depending on substrate). Efflorescence neutralization with acid or TSP. Chalk remediation. Scrape/feather failing/peeling areas. Crack filling and spall patching at QT3+. Condition modifier: GOOD=1.0x, FAIR=1.5x, POOR=2.0x on prep tasks.

tasks.name: Power Wash Masonry Surface
tasks.description: High-pressure wash 1500-3000 PSI per substrate type. Dual purpose: cleaning (dirt, mildew, algae, loose efflorescence) and mechanical paint removal (failing/peeling areas). Limestone max 2000 PSI. 24-48 hr dry time mandatory after wash. RRP: containment required for wash water if lead paint present.

quality_notes.QT2: Light wash for cleaning only. 1500 PSI standard.
quality_notes.QT3: Full wash with TSP. 2000 PSI for paint removal on failing areas.
quality_notes.QT4: Thorough wash with TSP. Systematic coverage. Targeted high-pressure on failing zones.

tasks.notes: KEY departure from FC siding RP (which PROHIBITS power washing). Masonry handles pressure. Condition modifier applies.

tasks.name: Efflorescence Neutralization Treatment
tasks.description: Dry brush loose salt deposits. Treat with dilute muriatic acid (brick, CMU, concrete) or phosphoric acid/TSP (limestone). Rinse thoroughly. Dry 48-72 hours. Active/recurring efflorescence = STOP WORK. Dormant efflorescence only.
tasks.notes: Masonry-specific RP task. Not present in siding/trim RP. Limestone constraint: no muriatic acid.

tasks.name: Chalk Remediation Pre-Treatment
tasks.description: Chemical chalk removal on areas with stubborn chalk residue after power wash. Applied on smooth-painted masonry (block, concrete) where chalk persists. Prep step before chalk-binding primer.

tasks.name: Scrape Failing/Peeling Paint + Feather Edges
tasks.description: Hand scrape loose/failing/peeling paint with carbide scraper. Power wash handles much of the removal on masonry (unlike wood/FC). Hand scraping for remaining loose edges. Feather-edge scraped boundaries with 80-grit. Condition modifier: GOOD=skip, FAIR=moderate, POOR=heavy.
tasks.notes: Less manual scraping needed on masonry vs wood (power wash does more work on hard substrate). Condition modifier applies.

tasks.name: Crack Filling — Hairline Cracks
tasks.description: Fill cosmetic hairline cracks (<1/4 inch) with elastomeric masonry crack filler. Flexible to accommodate thermal movement. QT3+ only — QT2 skips minor cosmetic repair.
tasks.notes: QT2 skips. Structural cracks (>1/4 inch) are outside scope — refer to structural engineer.

tasks.name: Spall/Chip Patching
tasks.description: Patch small spalled/chipped areas with cementitious patch compound. Feather edges flush with surrounding surface. Allow 24-hr cure before priming. QT3+ only.
tasks.notes: QT2 skips. Extensive spalling = structural concern, outside painting scope.

tasks.name: General Surface Repair
tasks.description: General masonry surface repair: fill voids, blend previous patch repairs, smooth rough transitions. QT3+ only.

tasks.name: Post-Prep Dust and Debris Cleanup
tasks.description: Remove scraping debris, power wash residue, acid treatment residue, patch dust. Blow down or brush entire surface before priming. Critical step — debris contamination under primer causes adhesion failure.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Power wash first (24-48 hr dry) -> Efflorescence treatment -> Chalk remediation -> Scrape/feather -> Crack fill -> Spall patch -> Surface repair -> Dust cleanup last.

sop_modules.name: Caulk Assessment and Replacement — Masonry-to-Trim Junctions
sop_modules.description: Assess and replace failed caulk at masonry-to-trim junctions (window/door casings, frieze, utility penetrations). Limited scope compared to siding RP (no butt joints on masonry). Polyurethane caulk Class 25/50.

tasks.name: Caulk Joint Assessment
tasks.description: Inspect all masonry-to-trim junctions for caulk condition. Failed, cracked, or missing caulk at window/door casings, frieze joints, utility penetrations. Document LF requiring replacement.

tasks.name: Remove Failed Caulk
tasks.description: Cut and remove failed caulk from masonry-to-trim joints. Clean joint channel. Condition modifier applies (POOR condition = more failed joints).

tasks.name: Apply New Caulk
tasks.description: Apply polyurethane caulk (Class 25/50) to cleaned joints. Tool smooth. 2-4 hr cure before overcoating.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Assess -> Remove failed -> Apply new. Caulk after power wash dry time, before priming.

sop_modules.name: State-Driven Primer Application
sop_modules.description: Primer selection driven by substrate state: SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT = skip prime (verified adhesion); SS_EXT_CHALKING = chalk-binding full surface; SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT = alkali-resistant spot on bare + acrylic stain-block; SS_EXT_PEELING = alkali-resistant on bare + full acrylic stain-block. spray_backroll primary, brush_roll fallback.

tasks.name: Chalk-Binding Primer — Spray/Backroll
tasks.description: Apply chalk-binding primer to full masonry surface. Spray lead, backroll follow within wet edge. MANDATORY for SS_EXT_CHALKING.

tasks.name: Chalk-Binding Primer — Brush/Roll
tasks.description: Apply chalk-binding primer via brush/roll. Fallback method. Full surface.

tasks.name: Alkali-Resistant Spot Prime — Exposed Bare Masonry
tasks.description: Spot prime all exposed bare masonry areas with alkali-resistant primer. pH 12-13 substrate requires alkali resistance. Applied by brush to bare spots. Standard acrylic primer NOT suitable on bare masonry.
tasks.notes: Brush application for spot priming regardless of primary method. Bare masonry areas need targeted application.

tasks.name: Acrylic Stain-Block Primer — Spray/Backroll
tasks.description: Full or spot acrylic stain-block primer over intact painted areas. spray_backroll. For SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT (spot or full) and SS_EXT_PEELING (full surface).

tasks.name: Acrylic Stain-Block Primer — Brush/Roll
tasks.description: Acrylic stain-block primer via brush/roll. Fallback method.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: SS_EXT_CHALKING: chalk-binding only. SS_EXT_FAILING/PEELING: alkali-resistant spot prime on bare areas FIRST, then acrylic stain-block over remaining. SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT: skip this module.

sop_modules.name: First Finish Coat
sop_modules.description: First finish coat — spray_backroll primary (2-person: sprayer leads, backroller follows), brush_roll fallback. Acrylic or elastomeric per coating_system dimension.

tasks.name: Finish Coat 1 — Spray/Backroll
tasks.description: First finish coat spray_backroll. Spray lead, backroll follow within wet edge. 2-person crew mandatory. Backroll forces coating into pores.

tasks.name: Finish Coat 1 — Brush/Roll
tasks.description: First finish coat brush/roll. Fallback for smaller areas.

sop_modules.name: Interstage Inspection and Maintenance
sop_modules.description: Between-coat inspection, QT4 interstage sand, touch-up. QT2 skips (single coat). QT3: spot inspect. QT4: full surface inspect + light sand.

tasks.name: Interstage Inspection
tasks.description: Inspect first finish coat for holidays, runs, sags, overspray. QT3: spot check. QT4: systematic scan.

quality_notes.QT3: Spot check at 6-10 ft. Focus on coverage uniformity.
quality_notes.QT4: Systematic scan at 6 ft. Document defects for touch-up.

tasks.name: Interstage Light Sand (QT4 Only)
tasks.description: Light sand with 220-grit between finish coats. QT4 only. Improves intercoat adhesion and finish quality on masonry.

tasks.name: Interstage Touch-Up
tasks.description: Touch up defects found during interstage inspection. Brush touch-up of holidays, drips, and missed areas.

sop_modules.name: Second Finish Coat
sop_modules.description: Second finish coat — QT3/QT4 only. QT2 is single-coat. Same method as first coat.

tasks.name: Finish Coat 2 — Spray/Backroll
tasks.description: Second finish coat spray_backroll. QT3/QT4 only. 2-person crew.

tasks.name: Finish Coat 2 — Brush/Roll
tasks.description: Second finish coat brush/roll. QT3/QT4 only.

sop_modules.name: Final Inspection, Touch-Up, Protection Teardown, Equipment Cleanup, Site Cleanup, Customer Walkthrough
sop_modules.description: RP cleanup module. Final inspection, touch-up, protection teardown, equipment cleanup, site debris cleanup (including scraping debris collection), customer walkthrough (RP-specific, occupied home).

tasks.name: Final Walkthrough Inspection
tasks.description: Final inspection of all masonry surfaces. QT2: ground-level scan. QT3: 6-10 ft walkthrough. QT4: systematic 6 ft inspection with binoculars for upper elevations.

quality_notes.QT4: Systematic 6 ft inspection. Binoculars for high areas.

tasks.name: Final Touch-Up
tasks.description: Touch up defects found during final inspection. Brush work on holidays, drips, missed areas.

tasks.name: Protection Teardown
tasks.description: Remove all landscape/hardscape/fixture/HVAC/vehicle/ground cover protection. Fold and stage materials for removal.

tasks.name: Equipment Cleanup
tasks.description: Clean spray equipment, brushes, rollers, trays. Flush spray lines. Properly dispose of waste.

tasks.name: Site Debris Cleanup
tasks.description: Collect and dispose of scraping debris, paint chips, caulk remnants, patch material waste, acid treatment containers. RP generates more debris than NC.

tasks.name: Customer Walkthrough
tasks.description: Walk customer through completed work. Point out treatment areas, explain maintenance. RP-specific — occupied home context.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Final inspect -> Final touch-up -> Protection teardown -> Equipment cleanup -> Site debris cleanup -> Customer walkthrough.

sop_modules.name: Shared Exterior Lead-Safe RRP Module
sop_modules.description: EPA RRP Rule 40 CFR 745. Pre-1978 building gate. Lead screening, containment setup, wet scraping, HEPA vacuum, containment teardown. Shared across all exterior RP specs. Higher activation probability on masonry than FC siding (masonry buildings more likely pre-1978).

tasks.name: Lead Paint Screening
tasks.description: XRF or swab test for lead paint on masonry surfaces. Per-elevation.

tasks.name: RRP Containment Setup
tasks.description: 6-mil poly ground containment extending 10 ft from structure. Per-elevation setup. Includes containment of power wash water runoff (masonry-specific).

tasks.name: RRP Wet Scraping Methods
tasks.description: Wet scraping per EPA RRP Rule. Misting surface before scraping to control lead dust. Required whenever disturbing paint on lead-positive masonry.

tasks.name: HEPA Vacuum Lead Dust Collection
tasks.description: HEPA vacuum all surfaces and containment area after scraping/power washing. Collect visible paint chips.

tasks.name: RRP Containment Teardown and Disposal
tasks.description: Remove containment. Dispose of contaminated poly and debris per EPA requirements.
